data.content_ref: inline:SRC_006 contradicts SRC_008 by implying a non-zero pen price ($2.50) while SRC_008 claims P=$0; both are refuted by SRC_002's correct algebraic derivation of P=$1.25. SRC_006's error (mis-segmentation yielding N=$10, P=$2.50) and SRC_008's claim (P=$0) share the failure mode of violating the total-sum constraint when checked against N+P=12.50: SRC_006 is only consistent if N=$10, but then N+P=$12.50 gives P=$2.50, which contradicts the stated premium N=P+10. This is refuted if SRC_008 is not actually a pen-price claim, or if SRC_006's residual arithmetic is shown to be self-consistent under a different parsing.
